page.title: A Bizarre Run: Roblox Racing Game Guide & Codes
page.meta_description: A Bizarre Run is a JoJo-inspired racing game on Roblox with stage-based tracks. Here's what we know, how to start racing, and the status of codes.
page.tagline: A JoJo-flavoured Roblox racer where every stage throws something bizarre at you.
overview: A Bizarre Run is a Roblox racing game that wears its inspiration on its sleeve: its stages are built around Steel Ball Run, the horse-race arc of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. You start in a lobby, run through a tutorial, and then throw yourself into races across stage-based tracks.

Creators covering the game in November 2026 called it one of the best racing games on Roblox and walked through the tutorial, the lobby and their first race. Later that month, the Stage 3 update got its own full gameplay showcase, with a separate "scary monster stand" update mentioned alongside it.

If you're here looking for codes, slow down: none of the sources we checked list any working A Bizarre Run codes. There is no verified code list, no in-game code redemption described, and no developer post confirming codes exist. Treat any code list you see elsewhere with suspicion until the game itself confirms it.

how_to_play: Open the game on Roblox and load into the lobby.
Play through the tutorial so you know how a race starts and what the track expects from you.
Take a look around the lobby before queuing — creator videos show a lobby segment before the first race.
Join a race and complete the stage; stages are the main progression path, with Stage 3 being the headline update.
Keep an eye on update coverage for new stages and stand-themed additions.
tips: Don't skip the tutorial — it's the quickest way to understand the race flow before you're dropped into a stage.
Spend a minute in the lobby first; it's where you get your bearings before the first race.
Expect stage-specific gimmicks rather than a plain sprint — Stage 3 in particular is built around the Steel Ball Run theme.
New content arrives in waves, so check back after updates rather than assuming the stage list is final.

faq.q: Are there any A Bizarre Run codes?
faq.a: Not that we can confirm. None of the store pages, news items or creator videos we checked list a working code, and no code redemption system is described. Any code list claiming otherwise isn't backed by the game's own channels.

faq.q: What is A Bizarre Run about?
faq.a: It's a Roblox racing game whose stages are based on Steel Ball Run from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. You start in a lobby, learn the ropes in a tutorial, then race through stage-based tracks.

faq.q: Where can I play A Bizarre Run?
faq.a: On Roblox. The game page is at roblox.com/games/108055619068945/A-Bizarre-Run.
The sources don't state a price, so we can't confirm it. Check the Roblox game page for the current details.
